newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to freeze excutives' wages.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to freeze excutives' wages.

text.p: Sixty-seven executives and senior officials, including the governor, of the central Bank of Korea have agreed to freeze their wages for 1997, a bank spokesman said on Monday.
The spokesman said the wage freeze was intended to contribute to honing South Korea's international competitiveness and to fight the national economy's current difficulties.
Earlier, South Korean industrial groups, their profits savaged by falling exports, decided to freeze executive pay.
The Yonhap news agency said many domestic banks were expected to follow the central bank's decision.
